name: Ruins of Constellas
summary: At Mount Hyjal’s roots, Jadefire satyrs hold the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood. Their fel magic has corrupted the settlement’s moonwell.

sections.title: A Defiled Sanctuary
sections.body:
Broken arches and crumbling plazas mark the night elf settlement that once stood at Constellas. The Burning Legion marched through Felwood during the Third War and shattered the haven. Demonic corruption followed. Now Jadefire satyrs hold the ruins.

Xavathras leads the satyrs as they tend the defiled moonwell. They turn its pure waters into fel power for their master, Lord Xavaric.

sections.title: The Struggle for Cleansing
sections.body: Those who work to cleanse Felwood face a foul corruption at Constellas. Xavathras and his Jadefire satyrs guard their tents among the ruins. At the heart of the settlement lies the tainted moonwell. The satyrs fight to keep their work safe from anyone who would end it.

faq.q: What was Constellas before the corruption?
faq.answer: Constellas was an ancient night elf settlement near Mount Hyjal’s base. Its architecture and moonwell suggest a serene grove devoted to Elune and nature before the Burning Legion invaded Felwood during the Third War.
Jadefire satyrs occupy the ruins, led by Xavathras. They cultivate demonic energies throughout the area under Lord Xavaric’s command.

faq.q: What happened to the moonwell in Constellas?
faq.answer: Jadefire satyrs seized the moonwell and corrupted it with fel magic. Xavathras tends it as a toxic source of fel energy instead of a wellspring of Elune’s soothing blessings.
Xavaric is a cruel Jadefire satyr served by Xavathras. The satyrs tend Constellas’s corrupted moonwell on Xavaric’s behalf.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may see Constellas’s desecration and its corrupted moonwell as an affront to Elune. Driving out the Jadefire satyrs would restore what they defiled.
As a druid, you may see Constellas’s defiled moonwell as a reminder of your vow to restore balance to Felwood.
